title: Contact Lens Order Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=contacts:order
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(lens_brand) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many contact lens order events land each day and how many distinct lens brand values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest contact lens order records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct lens brand values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much contact lens order activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
